AI Video Bootcamp 1.0.0 — initial release

- Instantly turn video recordings into course-ready bootcamp lessons with AI-driven editing: just upload a file, describe your output, and download a finished video.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB; all processing handled in the cloud.
- Handles cutting videos into lessons, adding chapter titles, overlays, and more via user prompts.
- Built-in token and session management to simplify setup; 100 free credits with anonymous login.
- Exports high-quality MP4s (and other formats) in about 1–2 minutes per job; ideal for educators and course creators.
- Responsive error handling and session tracking, including balance checking and file/format validation.
